title: UGC (user-generated content)
one_liner: Brands pay you to make videos they post on their own pages and ads.
followers: None. Brands judge your samples, not your follower count.
steps: Make 3 sample videos with your phone (unboxing, review, how-to).
Put them in a simple portfolio or link-in-bio page.
Pitch brands directly or apply to briefs on UGC marketplaces.
Agree price, usage rights and deadlines in writing, then deliver.
catch: Brands want to see samples before they say yes, and rates vary a lot by niche and usage rights.

match.first_step: Film 3 samples this week: an unboxing, a review and a how-to.
